verdict.rationale: GitHub's marketing page explicitly claims 'Launch a full, cloud-based development environment in seconds' (github-docs-3), directly matching the story, but this is a single thin marketing line with no elaboration on Codespaces features, setup workflow, or independent/hands-on corroboration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Codespaces setup/config, first-hand user reports confirming fast launch times, and any independent verification of the 'seconds' claim.
